pages.title: Ownership
pages.text: Tame a horse fully and it becomes **owned** and starts using Better Horses' systems.

pages.title: Command Wheel
pages.text:
Look at an owned horse and press your **Horse Command Wheel** key to open the radial menu. Pick a wedge to issue it, or click outside to cancel.

- **Follow**: the horse trails after you.
- **Wander**: it grazes and roams a 32x32 area around where you gave the command.
- **Stay**: it waits where you left it.
- **Set Home**: marks the spot as home and switches to Stay.
- **Return Home**: sends it back to that saved spot.

pages.title: Whistle and Bond
pages.text:
Press your **Horse Whistle** key to whistle for your horse. Nearby mounts switch to **Follow**; distant ones are pulled closer. While riding, the same key opens the horse's info screen instead.

Bond runs 0 to 100, and every 20 points adds speed and jump strength.

- Stay near your horse for slow passive gain.
- A **Name Tag** gives +10 bond.
- A **Golden Apple** gives +2 bond.
